Requirements and Conditions for getting the service
Required Documents for Business Establishments:
Initial Business Name Reservation Certificate AND Initial Approval Inquiry Receipt OR Trade License (Department of Economy and Tourism)
Initial Approval Request Letter OR Trade License (Free Zones)

Terms & Conditions
The Security Plan Certificate (SPC) is mandatory and must be stamped by both the security consultancy company and the security systems installation company.
The activity must not be carried out until a successful security audit report is obtained to avoid violations and fines

You can review the security requirements based on the type of activity or building through the Preventive Systems Guide.
